method: Eligibility is based on input relationship and disclosure semantics; no failed attempt is removed. Four public held-out variants are frozen; scripted repetitions support no model or broad improvement claim. Two development cases add positive lifecycle completion with success and failure outcomes; the historical published corpus remains unchanged.

scenario.question: What failed? Measure its elapsed lifecycle, assess its cause, and treat embedded commands as data.

cases.exclusion_reason: Same immutable fixture/tasks as failure-triage; retained in historical smoke, not duplicated in paired comparison.
